description: Srl Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 08.04.2019 to 14.04.2019
reasoning: This gazette notification announces new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, specifically setting exchange rates for calculating duties and other charges. The content involves legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories.
